decisions.quote: Research objectives were to evaluate the effectiveness of training on a facet of clothing appearance not studied previously, conduct training with care providers under naturalistic (non-simulated) conditions, and assess social validity of the clothing intervention (Wolf, 1978).
decisions.reason: The phrase 'five-case replication series' refers to repeating the intervention across five participants within this paper; the study evaluates a previously unstudied facet of clothing appearance rather than re-testing a published finding.

decisions.quote: Like McClannahan et al. (1990) and Buckley et al. (2025), the present five-case replication series did not focus directly on teaching students dressing skills, rather evaluated the effects of training care providers to monitor and assist the students wearing personal clothing.
decisions.reason: Because this paper is not a replication of an earlier published study, the original study field is inapplicable; Buckley et al. (2025) is cited only as background context.
